description: Mask low-complexity regions of a DNA sequence with symmetric DUST (SDUST, Morgulis 2006; same output as lh3/sdust): every perfect interval of at most windowSize bases whose DUST score exceeds the threshold is masked. N and other IUPAC codes are accepted and split the scan like sdust. Optional dustmasker linker merge and soft (lower-case) masking. Returns a same-length masked string.

sequence.description: DNA sequence (A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N; case-insensitive)

threshold.description: DUST threshold above which to mask (default 2.0)

maskChar.description: Mask character (default 'N'; ignored when softMask is true)

linker.description: dustmasker linker: merge masked intervals separated by fewer than linker unmasked bases (1-32, default 1 = sdust/dustmasker default)

softMask.description: Soft-mask: lower-case masked bases, upper-case the rest (dustmasker -outfmt fasta)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
